claim_scope_review.title: Two infinite seeded families
claim_scope_review.decision: Consistent with included final proofs and their scoped acceptances.
claim_scope_review.scope_check: The infinite families retain fixed r, exponential fixed-deviation scope, a concentrating seed, and the starts-with-1 hypothesis. No general closure outside those hypotheses is asserted.
dependencies: Bóna exact growth equality for starts-with-1 patterns

claim_scope_review.title: Frontier and small-value localization
claim_scope_review.decision: Consistent with included final proofs and their scoped acceptances.
claim_scope_review.scope_check: The fixed-alpha frontier and sublinear-small-value tails retain completion bias and the positive-density entropy cost; alpha of length one is separated.
dependencies: Catalan descendant comparison; exact unique minimum-deletion ancestry

claim_scope_review.title: Completion-weighted bulk and pointwise limits
claim_scope_review.decision: Consistent with included final proofs and their scoped acceptances.
claim_scope_review.scope_check: The weighted inversion reduction and pointwise/maximum-displacement limitations do not imply a weak-limit counterexample. The one-point mass correction is retained.

claim_scope_review.title: Scalar numerical assumptions are insufficient
claim_scope_review.decision: Consistent with included final proofs and their scoped acceptances.
claim_scope_review.scope_check: The repaired numerical tree is distinguished from the coarse tree that fails the sharper bound. Neither is represented as a principal avoidance class.

claim_scope_review.title: First-hit prefix state
claim_scope_review.decision: Consistent with included final proofs and their scoped acceptances.
claim_scope_review.scope_check: The sufficient prefix state retains its full standardized pattern and absent flag; no scalar-state, finite-state, or uniform compressed-state law is inferred.

claim_scope_review.title: Growth packing and spatial compatibility
claim_scope_review.decision: Consistent with included final proofs and their scoped acceptances.
claim_scope_review.scope_check: The strict growth and packing conclusions are relative to Av(alpha skew-sum 1), with alpha fixed and length at least two. Deterministic spatial obstructions are separated from uniform probabilities.

claim_scope_review.title: General diagonal-cut states
claim_scope_review.decision: Consistent with included final proofs and their scoped acceptances.
claim_scope_review.scope_check: Exact cut profiles retain closed context and multiplicities. Rationality and strict growth gaps are for each fixed K and do not control width divided by n.

claim_scope_review.title: Canonical staircase prefixes
claim_scope_review.decision: Consistent with included final proofs and their scoped acceptances.
claim_scope_review.scope_check: The prefix theorem fixes the number of initial canonical cells. The map does not turn it into an arbitrary moving-index or growing-width concentration theorem.

claim_scope_review.title: Directed kernel and both completion factors
claim_scope_review.decision: Consistent with included final proofs and their scoped acceptances.
claim_scope_review.scope_check: The directed canonical kernel and marked-cell identity retain both incoming and outgoing completion factors and the full-class law.

claim_scope_review.title: Squared-kernel bridge and its obstruction
claim_scope_review.decision: Consistent with included final proofs and their scoped acceptances.
claim_scope_review.scope_check: The conditional squared-kernel implication is paired with the later proof that its strict hypothesis is impossible. The reweighting obstruction is limited to positive diagonal Hilbert-Schmidt reweighting beyond rho.

claim_scope_review.title: Arbitrary-index isolated blocks
claim_scope_review.decision: Consistent with included final proofs and their scoped acceptances.
claim_scope_review.scope_check: Isolation and fixed-width hypotheses are retained. A single constant fraction c below one is distinguished from largest-cell sublinearity.

claim_scope_review.title: Rerooting and one-sided marks
claim_scope_review.decision: Consistent with included final proofs and their scoped acceptances.
claim_scope_review.scope_check: The operative proof is the one-point rerooting version; removed incoming-shuffle information is retained. Common one-sided marks and deterministic graded mountains do not settle the bulk law.

claim_scope_review.title: Terminal and joint endpoint marks
claim_scope_review.decision: Consistent with included final proofs and their scoped acceptances.
claim_scope_review.scope_check: The terminal lift retains the inverse-pattern guard and factor-two ambiguity. Separate or joint endpoint marks are not multiplied into an unsupported bulk estimate.

claim_scope_review.title: One-ended and two-ended window certificates
claim_scope_review.decision: Consistent with included final proofs and their scoped acceptances.
claim_scope_review.scope_check: Fixed-width minimax certificates and the g1/g2 calibration are separated from the unknown true all-width gaps. Two-ended and profile supplements are included.
dependencies: Bevan–Brignall–Elvey Price–Pantone domino enumeration and construction

claim_scope_review.title: Adaptive windows and true gaps
claim_scope_review.decision: Consistent with included final proofs and their scoped acceptances.
claim_scope_review.scope_check: The adaptive criterion remains conditional on true-gap divergence. Obstructions to available certificates, including widths one and two with true gaps, are not promoted to an all-width true-gap obstruction.

claim_scope_review.title: Increasing pairs and internal chains
claim_scope_review.decision: Consistent with included final proofs and their scoped acceptances.
claim_scope_review.scope_check: The increasing-pair criterion is stated as an exact equivalent weak-limit target. Both completion-weighted internal and actual cross-edge pair terms remain necessary.

claim_scope_review.title: Arbitrary-length low-chain runs
claim_scope_review.decision: Consistent with included final proofs and their scoped acceptances.
claim_scope_review.scope_check: Restricted LIS-at-most-two paths have the stated upper growth bound. Macroscopic run tails retain their small-boundary condition and the credited 81/8 lower bound.

claim_scope_review.title: Height-three size-weight threshold
claim_scope_review.decision: Consistent with included final proofs and their scoped acceptances.
claim_scope_review.scope_check: The height-three result is an upper bound and a pure size-weight method barrier, not a lower growth bound or a concentration upgrade. The Norton v3 safeguard remains explicit.

claim_scope_review.title: Rectangle deletion and occupied/sparse branches
claim_scope_review.decision: Consistent with included final proofs and their scoped acceptances.
claim_scope_review.scope_check: Rectangle reconstruction retains its admissibility indicator. Favorable entropy and occupied/sparse reductions do not automatically control contamination or the residual sparse branch.

claim_scope_review.title: Comb and near-empty rectangles
claim_scope_review.decision: Consistent with included final proofs and their scoped acceptances.
claim_scope_review.scope_check: Comb and near-empty examples are actual deterministic constructions with their final supplement attached. No positive probability under exact uniform sampling is inferred.

claim_scope_review.title: Folding information and quadratic model gaps
claim_scope_review.decision: Consistent with included final proofs and their scoped acceptances.
claim_scope_review.scope_check: The corrected folding derivative separates output markings from source coordinates and supplies the stronger coordinate-record fiber argument. Quadratic gaps belong to a distinct comparison model only.
dependencies: Albert–Brignall–Ruskuc–Vatter monotone staircase existence; Bevan grid growth attribution
